Let me analyze this question carefully.

The key facts to verify:
- Serial killer who hanged himself
- Wakefield Prison
- January 2004
- Found guilty of 15 murders
- Four years after conviction (so convicted around 2000)

Harold Shipman was a British doctor and serial killer who was convicted in January 2000 of 15 murders (though he's suspected of many more). He was imprisoned at Wakefield Prison and hanged himself on January 13, 2004 - exactly four years after his conviction.

Dennis Nilsen was also a British serial killer, but he died in May 2018 at HMP Full Sutton (not Wakefield), and he died from natural causes (pulmonary embolism), not by hanging. He was convicted in 1983, not 2000.

All the specific details in the question match Harold Shipman perfectly
